extracted.intended_audience: Poets and writers submitting poetry or letters to Poetry (the magazine) / prospective contributors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for submitting poems (including visual poetry) and letters to Poetry magazine: what works are eligible, technical/file and length limits, submission process via Submittable, payment and rights, and policies on simultaneous/multiple submissions and response timing.

rubrics_metrics.name: What kind of work Poetry is looking for
rubrics_metrics.description: We examine all work received and accept that which seems best. We consider original works written in the English language as well as translations of poetry into English.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regret that the volume of submissions and small staff do not permit individual criticism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previously published material (eligibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: No. We cannot consider anything that has been previously published or accepted for publication, anywhere, in any form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that has appeared online is considered to have been previously published and should not be submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment and rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Yes. Payment is made on publication at the rate of $10 per line (with a minimum payment of $300), and $150 per page of prose, for first serial rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All rights will revert to the author upon publication. Authors will also receive two contributor copies of the issue in which their work appears.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method (online-only)
rubrics_metrics.description: As of July 2013, we no longer accept paper submissions. We now have an online system for you to send us your work via poetry.submittable.com.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The system will securely send editors your work and e-mail you a confirmation that it has been received. Your account will be set up during your first submission; there is no need to create an account beforehand. Once submitted, you can check status by signing into your Submittable account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted file types for poetry submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the 'Poetry' category, submit files in one of the following formats only: Word document (.doc) files; Rich Text Format (.rtf) files; Text (.txt) files; Portable Document Format (.pdf) files; Word Perfect (.ppf) files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual Poetry category file types
rubrics_metrics.description: We now also have a 'Visual Poetry' category which accepts the following: JPEG, TIFF, PNG, PDF, and Word document files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission limits: number of poems and page count
rubrics_metrics.description: Please note that submissions are limited to four poems (1 file), and should not exceed ten pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poems should be submitted in a single file, with poems separated by titles or page breaks. Please include all writer contact info on the first page of the submitted file.

rubrics_metrics.name: When to submit / multiple submissions policy
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We ask that you do not make multiple submissions: please wait for a response to your submission before sending new work. Adhering to our single submission of four poems or fewer at a time will help ensure a timely response.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simultaneous submissions policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Does Poetry accept simultaneous submissions? Yes!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your work is accepted elsewhere, please just add a note to your submission in Submittable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response time and notification
rubrics_metrics.description: We will do our best to respond within seven months from the day of receipt, but are sometimes slower in responding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please be patient; it is our goal to make sure each submission gets a good read. Please ensure that you set your e-mail spam filter to allow mail from both poetryfoundation.org and poetrymagazine.org; otherwise notification regarding your submission may be marked as junk mail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters to the Editor — purpose and handling
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry is looking for thought-provoking responses to work published in the magazine, as well as letters that raise new questions about the state of contemporary poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To send a letter, fill out the form. If chosen, we will notify you by phone. If you have not heard within two weeks, assume we will not be using it. All letters may be edited for length and clarity, and may appear online, in print, or both.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help/contact for submission system issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Who can I contact if I'm having trouble using the online system?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please contact Submittable by e-mail ([email protected]) or by phone: 855.467.8264.

rubrics_metrics.name: Read the magazine before submitting
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone contemplating a submission is encouraged to examine the magazine before sending a manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To subscribe or order a single copy, links are provided on the site — reviewing the magazine helps ensure your work is a good fit.
